title: Editorial: introduce module map entry
body: This PR introduces a `module map entry` struct as the value type of `module map`, in preparation for https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/12922 which will add `integrity metadata` to `module map entry`. The `module map entry` struct is structured similarly to `preload entry`: https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/links.html#preload-entry Specifically, this change: - Defines `module map entry` with `module script` (either `"fetching"` or a `module script`, defaulting to `"fetching"`) and `on complete callbacks` (a `list` of algorithms waiting for the fetch to complete), together with the invariant that `module script` is a `module script` if and only if `on complete callbacks` is empty. - Replaces `module map`'s value type (previously either a `module script` or a `list` of algorithms) with `module map entry`. - Updates `fetch a single module script` to operate on `module map entry` via a local `entry` variable, and resets `on complete callbacks` to `« »` when setting `module script` on completion so the invariant holds before callbacks run.
